study_identification_part.si_4_title: Age-atypical brain functional networks in autism spectrum disorder: a normative modeling approach

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used the ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) dataset, which is a large-scale open-access neuroimaging dataset for ASD containing resting-state fMRI data from 1495 individuals collected at 17 data acquisition centers. The specific version (ABIDE-I or ABIDE-II) is not explicitly stated, but based on context (reference to Di Martino et al., 2014 and dataset size), this appears to be ABIDE-I.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ABIDE dataset is a large-scale open-access neuroimaging dataset for ASD, which currently includes resting-state fMRI data from 1495 individuals collected at 17 data acquisition centers." ... "All the data analyzed in this study were sourced from the ABIDE dataset."
